source: Identity V in-game mini-map screenshots hosted by the Bilibili Identity V community wiki (BWIKI); downloaded from original patchwiki asset URLs.

officialEvidence.finding: Official mini-map support includes these three maps; expanded map supports floor switching. Detailed map no longer displays discovered dungeons.
Official map geometry adjustments affect Arms Factory and Hospital pallet zones. Old map-location overheads from 2023 should not be treated as current.
Further radar/obstacle fixes referenced Arms Factory Junkyard and Hospital. Current client equivalence remains unverified.

licenseObservation: The supplied images are game screenshots. No standalone open license for these files was verified on the source pages. Attribution does not imply an open license; do not label images CC0 or CC-BY.
versionCaveats: Source-page last-edit dates do not prove screenshot capture date or game client version.
The images have not been compared against the current live Korean/global game client.
Chinese source labels are retained; Korean overlay labels are direct translations and may differ from community callouts.
Map orientation is preserved from source; no measured compass north is asserted.
No exact cipher, chair, hatch, basement, spawn or pallet locations are supplied as verified fixed points.
Some stairs are drawn in both basement-candidate buildings. Do not infer a fixed active basement from these images.
Landmark coordinates are visually read approximate building/region/gate centers, not measured in-game navigation coordinates.
